```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(rfPermute)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
num_df_final_fullid <-
  oculina_final[, -c(1:7, 9:39, 16397:16426)]

num_df_final_fullid <- na.omit(num_df_final_fullid)
```

```{r}
Oculina_long <- num_df_final_fullid |>
  pivot_longer(-full_id,
               names_to = "Metabolite",
               values_to = "Abundance")
```

```{r}
Oculina_joined_host <- Oculina_long %>%
  left_join(feats_with_classes %>%
              select(metabolite, origin),
            by = c("Metabolite" = "metabolite")) |>
  filter(origin == "host") 

Oculina_joined_symb <- Oculina_long %>%
  left_join(feats_with_classes %>%
              select(metabolite, origin),
            by = c("Metabolite" = "metabolite")) |>
  filter(origin == "symbiont") 
```

```{r}
Oculina_host_wide <- Oculina_joined_host %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Metabolite,
              values_from = Abundance)

Oculina_host_wide_b <- Oculina_host_wide |>
  left_join(oculina_final |>
              select(full_id, bleaching))

Oculina_symb_wide <- Oculina_joined_symb %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Metabolite,
              values_from = Abundance)
```

```{r}
num_df_ocu_host_only <- Oculina_host_wide_b[, -c(1, 2)]
num_df_ocu_host_only$bleaching <- as.factor(num_df_ocu_host_only$bleaching)

num_df_ocu_symb_only <- Oculina_symb_wide[, -c(1, 2)]
```

```{r}
rfp_phen_host <- rfPermute(bleaching ~., data = num_df_ocu_host_only, na.action = na.omit, ntree = 500, num.rep = 1000)

rfp_phen_host

rfp_table_host <- as.data.frame(importance(rfp_phen_host))  # Convert to a data frame
rfp_table_host <- tibble::rownames_to_column(rfp_table_host, var = "Feature")
print(rfp_table_host)  # Display in console

significant_features_host <- rfp_table_host %>% filter(B.pval < 0.05 & NB.pval < 0.05)  # Adjust p-value threshold as needed

print(significant_features_host)
```

```{r}
write.csv(significant_features_host, file = "sig_feat_phenotype_host_rfpermute.csv")
```

```{r}
sig_feat_phen_host <- read.csv("sig_feat_phenotype_host_rfpermute.csv")
```

```{r}
sig_rows_host <- sig_feat_phen_host$Feature

num_df_sig_phen_host <- data.matrix(num_df_final |>
  select(all_of(sig_rows_host)))

log2FC_host <- sapply(sig_rows_host, function(met){
  
  B_vals_host  <- (num_df_sig_phen_host[ocu_final$bleaching == "B", met])
  NB_vals_host <- (num_df_sig_phen_host[ocu_final$bleaching == "NB", met])

  mean_B_host  <- mean(B_vals_host,  na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_NB_host <- mean(NB_vals_host, na.rm = TRUE)

  log2(mean_B_host / mean_NB_host)
})

log2FC_df_host <- data.frame(
  metabolite = sig_feat_phen_host,
  log2FC = log2FC_host
)
```

```{r, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 10}
library(ggpattern)

sig_feat_phen_joined_host <- log2FC_df_host |>
  inner_join(feats_with_classes, join_by(metabolite.Feature == metabolite)) |>
    select(metabolite.Feature, 
         `metabolite.MeanDecreaseAccuracy`, 
         compound_class, 
         log2FC,
         npc_number_superclass) |>
     mutate(Sign = if_else(log2FC > 0, "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic"))

sig_feat_phen_joined_host <- sig_feat_phen_joined_host |>
  arrange(desc(metabolite.MeanDecreaseAccuracy))

ggplot(sig_feat_phen_joined_host, 
       aes(x = reorder(metabolite.Feature, `metabolite.MeanDecreaseAccuracy`), 
           y = `metabolite.MeanDecreaseAccuracy`,
           fill = compound_class,
           pattern = Sign
           )) +
  geom_col_pattern(
  pattern_density = 0.2,
  pattern_spacing = 0.03
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FBE183FF", "#F4C40FFF", "#FE9B00FF", "#D8443CFF", "#9B3441FF", "#DE597CFF", "#E87B89FF", "#E6A2A6FF", "#AA7AA1FF", "#9F5691FF", "#633372FF", "#1F6E9CFF", "#2B9B81FF", "#92C051FF")
) +
  
  coord_flip() +  # Flip for better readability
  labs(title = "Variable Importance after rfPermute for Phenotype Classification with Host-only Metabolites",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Mean Decrease in Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
feature_ids <- names(oculina_final)[startsWith(names(oculina_final), "x")]

met_universe <- feats_with_classes %>%
 filter(metabolite %in% feature_ids) %>%
  distinct(metabolite, .keep_all = TRUE)


target_ids <- intersect(feature_ids, names(sym_only_df))

```

```{r}


fisher_class_enrichment <- function(target_ids, background_df) {

  background_ids <- unique(background_df$metabolite)

  target_ids <- intersect(unique(target_ids), background_ids)

  remainder_ids <- setdiff(background_ids, target_ids)

  target_df <- background_df %>%
    filter(metabolite %in% target_ids)

  remainder_df <- background_df %>%
    filter(metabolite %in% remainder_ids)

  all_classes <- sort(unique(background_df$compound_class))

  map_dfr(all_classes, function(current_class) {

    target_class_n <- sum(
      target_df$compound_class == current_class,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    target_other_n <- nrow(target_df) - target_class_n

    remainder_class_n <- sum(
      remainder_df$compound_class == current_class,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    remainder_other_n <- nrow(remainder_df) - remainder_class_n

    contingency_table <- matrix(
      c(
        target_class_n,
        target_other_n,
        remainder_class_n,
        remainder_other_n
      ),
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )

    test <- fisher.test(
      contingency_table,
      alternative = "greater"
    )

    tibble(
      compound_class = current_class,
      count_in_sym = target_class_n,
      total_sym_features = length(target_ids),
      count_in_background = remainder_class_n,
      total_background_features = length(remainder_ids),
      odds_ratio = unname(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )

  }) %>%

    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      enriched = odds_ratio > 1 & p_adj < 0.05
    ) %>%

    arrange(p_adj)
}

```

```{r}
class_enrichment_results <- fisher_class_enrichment(
  target_ids = target_ids,
  background_df = met_universe
)

# View significant enrichments
significant_enrichments <- class_enrichment_results %>%
  filter(enriched)

print(significant_enrichments, n = Inf)
```
